proxy_definition: For each valid pair (ll2,ll3), n = min(ll2+ll3,lmax)-abs(ll2-ll3)+1. Signature (0,2,0,2) gives the same l1 span to both drc3jj calls on the frozen valid domain. The deterministic preflight cost proxy is 3*n: two Wigner recurrences plus the explicit l1 accumulation span. Shard proxy cost is summed over all ll2 in the frozen band and ll3 in the shard.
allocation_method: Start with one shard per band; greedily add each of the remaining 54 shards to the band with maximal current total_proxy/shard_count. Within a band choose integer ll3 boundaries by cumulative proxy quantiles.
exactness_rule: A shard may split only the ll3 output domain. For every fixed ll3 the frozen ll2 outer order, both drc3jj calls, ascending l1 loop, xi multiplication and acc += xi recurrence must remain byte-for-byte equivalent. Assembly is placement/concatenation only; no arithmetic reduction across shards.
